about: Orders worth taking (Plans/ai_fleets.md, phase 6): a place wants so many of a good brought to it by a day, and pays above its market for them. Posted at the port, by the kind of place; heard of when you talk to people there; taken or not; brought in parts or whole when you lie there with the goods aboard, each part paid by the unit and tolled like a sale; other merchants fill them too. Keeping one is a deed (your standing there rises), breaking one too. Starting guesses, all editable.
units: chance a month a port posts one; units; premium: share above the market's price; days to deliver
about_premium: the most any order pays over the market's price there, as a share of it; a card's order asking more is cut to this
about_bonus: the most a whole order pays over the market, in deniers (ruling 14 of 7 Oct 2026: no card pays over 60 d); 0: no such cap
about_offer: game days an order offered by a card waits for an answer before it goes to another (ruling 12: an ordinary card waits a week)
about_warn: game days before its day that a taken order is called out in the log and the clock drops back; again on the last day

monastery.basis: monasteries needed wine for the mass, oil for the lamps and anointing, wax for candles, incense, parchment for books

royal seat.basis: a lord's hall wanted arms, horses, fine cloth, wine and glass for the table

town.basis: a bishop's city wanted wine and wax for its churches, spice and fine cloth for its households

about_ai: each day an order not yet filled may be filled by another merchant
